organic.title: How do I use the text-based video editor?
organic.snippet: To use text-based video editing in the video editor: Select the Transcript button above the Timeline. Select the Transcribe button next to the video clips

organic.title: Text-Based Video Editor: Edit Video like a Doc
organic.snippet: Vimeo's text-based editor is a tool designed to use the video's AI-generated transcript as a way for you to select text and delete its corresponding video clip.

organic.title: How do I use the text-based editor in the Vimeo mobile apps?
organic.snippet: Select Edit Video. Select Text-based editor. A transcript of the speech in your video will be generated. Double tap a word in the transcript to select it.

organic.title: How do I add and edit text in the editor?
organic.snippet: Text can be added to your video in the video editor. To add text: Select the Text button from the left-side panel. or select + Add text to add a blank text box.
